name: Francisco Assis - Après le § 29 - Am 28
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2025
part_text: 29a. Recalls that Türkiye exercises military control over nearly 40 % of the territory of the island of Cyprus, in violation of international law; regrets the lack of a firm response from the EU, in particular through the adoption of sanctions, against the Government of Türkiye, which supports and remains the only official entity to recognise the so-called Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus;
